Create dags/ directory and scaffold base Airflow DAG file
Description: As a Data Engineer, I want a dags/ directory with a base DAG file so that Airflow can discover and load the pipeline on startup.
Acceptance Criteria:
- dags/pipeline_dag.py exists at the repo root level
- File is importable by Airflow without syntax or import errors
- DAG appears in the Airflow UI when the service starts via docker compose --profile optional up airflow
- DAG ID is churn_data_pipeline
- default_args includes owner, retries: 2, retry_delay: 5 minutes

Summary: Implement Bronze ingestion Airflow task
Description: As a Data Engineer, I want an Airflow task that runs the Bronze ingestion step so that raw data is loaded into the bronze/ layer on a schedule.
Acceptance Criteria:
- A PythonOperator task with task_id ingest_bronze is defined in the DAG
- Task calls utils/bronze.ingest() without modification to that module
- Task runs successfully in isolation via Airflow's Test Task feature
- On success, data/bronze/ contains transactions.parquet, customer_metadata.parquet, and ancillary.parquet

Summary: Implement Silver cleaning Airflow tasks
Description: As a Data Engineer, I want Airflow tasks for each Silver cleaning step so that all four Silver layer outputs are produced and can be monitored individually.
Acceptance Criteria:
- Four PythonOperator tasks exist: clean_silver_transactions, clean_silver_crm, clean_silver_macro, build_date_dim
- Each task maps directly to its corresponding function in utils/silver.py
- All four tasks are downstream of ingest_bronze
- Each task can be re-run independently without affecting sibling tasks
- On success, all expected Silver parquet files exist in data/silver/

Summary: Implement Gold feature store Airflow tasks
Description: As a Data Engineer, I want Airflow tasks for building the Gold feature store and train/val/test splits so that the ML-ready datasets are produced as part of the automated pipeline.
Acceptance Criteria:
- Two PythonOperator tasks exist: build_gold_feature_store and build_gold_splits
- build_gold_feature_store is downstream of all four Silver tasks
- build_gold_splits is downstream of build_gold_feature_store only
- On success, data/gold/ contains feature_store.parquet, train_labeled.parquet, val_labeled.parquet, test_labeled.parquet

Summary: Configure DAG schedule
Description: Epic 1: Workflow Orchestration
Acceptance Criteria: High
column7: As a Data Engineer, I want the DAG to run on a monthly schedule with automatic retries so that the pipeline recovers from transient failures without manual intervention.
column8:
- DAG schedule_interval is set to @monthly
- catchup is set to False
- All tasks inherit retries: 2 and retry_delay: 5 minutes from default_args
- Full dependency chain enforces: bronze >> [silver tasks] >> gold_feature_store >> gold_splits
- A manually triggered run in the Airflow UI completes all tasks with status success

Summary: Create training script with baseline models and MLflow logging
Description: As an ML Engineer, I want a training script that trains multiple baseline models and logs each run to MLflow so that all experiments are reproducible and comparable in the UI.
Acceptance Criteria:
- src/train.py exists and runs end-to-end without errors inside the Docker container
- At least three model variants are trained: LogisticRegression, RandomForestClassifier, and GradientBoostingClassifier
- Each run is logged to MLflow experiment named churn_prediction
- Each run logs params, and metrics: auc_roc, f1, avg_precision on the validation set
- The serialised model artifact is attached to each MLflow run
- Running docker compose run jupyter python src/train.py against existing data/gold/ splits completes without errors

Summary: Implement Optuna hyperparameter tuning with nested MLflow runs
Description: As an ML Engineer, I want Optuna hyperparameter tuning integrated into the training script so that the best hyperparameters are found systematically and every trial is traceable.
Acceptance Criteria:
- An Optuna study runs a minimum of 20 trials for the best-performing model class
- Each trial is logged as a nested/child MLflow run under the parent experiment run
- The study's best_params and best_value are logged on the parent run
- The final optimised model is fitted on the full training set using best_params and saved as an MLflow artifact

Summary: Register best model in MLflow Model Registry
Description: As an ML Engineer, I want the best model automatically registered in the MLflow Model Registry at the end of training so that it is available for downstream serving and promotion.
Acceptance Criteria:
- The run with the highest auc_roc on the validation set is identified programmatically
- That model is registered in the MLflow Model Registry under the name ChurnModel
- The registered version is transitioned to stage Staging immediately after registration
- The MLflow UI shows ChurnModel with at least one version in Staging after the training script completes

Summary: Create batch inference script
Description: As an ML Engineer, I want a batch inference script that loads the Production-staged model from MLflow and writes predictions to a parquet file so that churn scores can be generated for any customer cohort.
Acceptance Criteria:
- src/predict.py accepts an input parquet path and an output parquet path
- Script loads the ChurnModel at stage Production from the MLflow registry
- Output parquet contains exactly these columns: customer_id, churn_probability, churn_prediction, predicted_at
- Script runs inside the Docker container without network access to external services beyond the local MLflow server
- Running the script against data/gold/test_labeled.parquet produces a valid output file

Summary: Wire training and inference tasks into Airflow DAG
Description: As a Data Engineer, I want the training and batch inference steps wired into the Airflow DAG so that model retraining and prediction generation happen automatically after the Gold layer is refreshed.
Acceptance Criteria:
- A BashOperator or PythonOperator task train_and_register is downstream of build_gold_splits
- The task runs src/train.py and completes successfully in the DAG
- DAG run order enforces: gold_splits >> train_and_register
- The task respects the same retry policy as other DAG tasks

Summary: Implement Evidently data drift monitoring report
Description: As an ML Engineer, I want automated data drift detection using Evidently so that I am alerted when the feature distribution in a current dataset diverges from the training baseline.
Acceptance Criteria:
- src/monitor.py exists and runs without errors inside the Docker container
- Script generates an Evidently report covering DataDriftPreset, DataQualityPreset, and TargetDriftPreset
- HTML report and JSON summary are saved to reports/ with a UTC timestamp in the filename
- A boolean drift_detected value is extracted from the JSON result
- drift_detected and n_drifted_features are logged as metrics on a dedicated MLflow monitoring run
- Both the HTML and JSON artifacts are attached to the MLflow run

Summary: Implement SHAP feature attribution drift tracking
Description: As an ML Engineer, I want SHAP-based feature attribution drift tracking so that silent model degradation is detected before it impacts business metrics.
Acceptance Criteria:
- src/shap_monitor.py exists and runs without errors against the Staging ChurnModel
- SHAP values are computed for both the reference (train) and current (val) datasets
- Mean absolute SHAP values per feature are compared between reference and current
- A bar chart of relative attribution change is saved to reports/shap_<timestamp>.png and logged as an MLflow artifact
- Per-feature attribution drift percentage is logged as individual MLflow metrics
- Any feature with relative attribution shift greater than 20% is printed to stdout as an ALERT

Summary: Implement automated data quality checks
Description: As a Data Engineer, I want automated data quality checks that validate Silver layer outputs so that malformed data is caught before it corrupts the Gold feature store.
Acceptance Criteria:
- src/data_quality.py exists with configurable rules per Silver table
- Checks cover: minimum row count, no nulls in key columns, numeric range bounds, and categorical cardinality
- A JSON quality report is written to reports/data_quality_<timestamp>.json on every run
- If any check fails, the script raises an exception with a descriptive message listing the failed table and check
- Running the script against valid data/silver/ parquet files exits with code 0

Summary: Wire data quality gate into Airflow DAG
Description: As a Data Engineer, I want the data quality gate wired into the Airflow DAG between the Silver and Gold tasks so that Gold layer builds are blocked when upstream data is invalid.
Acceptance Criteria:
- A PythonOperator task data_quality_gate is placed downstream of all Silver tasks and upstream of build_gold_feature_store
- If data_quality.run_quality_checks() raises an exception, the DAG task fails and all downstream Gold and training tasks are not triggered
- The quality report JSON is accessible from the task logs or written to a mounted reports/ volume

Summary: Wire monitoring tasks into Airflow DAG
Description: As a Data Engineer, I want drift monitoring and SHAP attribution checks wired into the Airflow DAG after training so that monitoring runs automatically every pipeline cycle.
Acceptance Criteria:
- A PythonOperator task run_drift_monitoring is downstream of train_and_register
- Task calls src/monitor.run_monitoring() and completes successfully
- DAG run order enforces: train_and_register >> run_drift_monitoring
- Task failure does not block the full DAG from completing (can be set to trigger_rule=all_done if appropriate)

Summary: Create .dockerignore to exclude large files from build context
Description: As a DevOps Engineer, I want a .dockerignore file so that large data files and local artifacts are excluded from the Docker build context, reducing build time and image size.
Acceptance Criteria:
- .dockerignore exists at the repository root
- The following paths are excluded: data/, mlruns/, reports/, .git/, .github/, eda/, __pycache__/, *.csv, *.parquet, .env
- docker build . completes without copying any .csv or .parquet files into the image
- Docker build context size is measurably smaller than before the .dockerignore was added

Summary: Add reports/ and mlruns/ volume mounts to docker-compose
Description: As a DevOps Engineer, I want reports/ and mlruns/ persisted as Docker volumes so that monitoring artifacts and MLflow experiment logs survive container restarts.
Acceptance Criteria:
- docker-compose.yaml mounts ./reports:/app/reports for the jupyter and airflow services
- docker-compose.yaml mounts ./mlruns:/app/mlruns for the jupyter, mlflow, and airflow services
- docker-compose.yaml mounts ./dags:/app/dags and ./src:/app/src for the airflow service
- After running docker compose down followed by docker compose up, the MLflow UI still shows all previous experiment runs
- Reports written during a container session are present in the host reports/ directory after the container stops

Summary: Add Docker-based test job to CI pipeline
Description: As a DevOps Engineer, I want the CI pipeline to run the full test suite inside the Docker container so that the tested environment exactly matches the container environment used in production.
Acceptance Criteria:
- A new job docker-test is added to .github/workflows/python-ci.yml
- The job builds the Docker image using docker build
- The job runs pytest tests/ -q inside the container via docker run with the data/ directory mounted as a volume
- The job passes on the main branch without errors
- Test results or logs are uploaded as a GitHub Actions artifact

Summary: Add monitoring script validation to CI pipeline
Description: As a DevOps Engineer, I want the monitoring scripts validated in CI so that regressions in data quality or drift detection are caught before merging to main.
Acceptance Criteria:
- The docker-test CI job (or a sibling job) runs python src/data_quality.py inside the container against mounted data/silver/ fixtures
- The same job runs python src/monitor.py against mounted data/gold/ splits
- Both commands must exit with code 0 for the CI job to pass
- PRs to main cannot be merged if either monitoring script exits with a non-zero code

Summary: Create model promotion script with champion/challenger comparison
Description: As an ML Engineer, I want a model promotion script that evaluates the Staging model against the current Production model before promoting so that only a genuinely better model is deployed to Production.
Acceptance Criteria:
- src/promote.py exists and runs without errors against the MLflow registry
- Script loads both the Staging and Production versions of ChurnModel
- Both versions are evaluated on data/gold/test_labeled.parquet using auc_roc as the comparison metric
- If the Staging model exceeds the Production model's AUC by at least 1 percentage point, it is promoted to Production
- If the threshold is not met, promotion is skipped and a warning is printed with the exact delta
- If no Production model exists, the Staging model is promoted unconditionally
- Promotion decision, staging_auc, production_auc, and delta are logged as MLflow metrics

Summary: Wire model promotion into Airflow DAG
Description: As a Data Engineer, I want the model promotion step wired into the Airflow DAG after monitoring so that champion/challenger evaluation runs automatically at the end of every pipeline cycle.
Acceptance Criteria:
- A PythonOperator task promote_model_if_better is downstream of run_drift_monitoring
- Task calls src/promote.promote_if_better() and completes successfully
- DAG run order enforces: run_drift_monitoring >> promote_model_if_better
- The full DAG end-to-end order is: bronze >> silver >> quality_gate >> gold >> train >> monitor >> promote
